sequence_description: Connector confusion: start SP-initiated auth targeting SAML connector, then post the SAMLResponse to a different connector callback path; must be rejected if callback is bound to the initiating connector.
description: [LLM-Judge] Posting a SAMLResponse to the wrong connector callback caused an HTTP 500 (server error) instead of a clean rejection (e.g., 4xx), suggesting an unhandled connector-mismatch/error path that could enable DoS or information leakage.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Posting a SAMLResponse to the wrong connector callback caused an HTTP 500 (server error) instead of a clean rejection (e.g., 4xx), suggesting an unhandled connector-mismatch/error path that could enable DoS or information leakage.
